remaining_host_checks: Controlled actual Elite Dangerous / Proton fullscreen organic-sampling and long-session acceptance has not been performed. Synthetic game focus and native application interaction evidence must not be described as actual Elite gameplay proof.

Clean-distribution system package installation and audible hardware voice/device output remain environment acceptance checks. SAPI voices/DirectWrite/WinForms are native platform adaptations, not a Windows binary ABI.

No vendor Linux update feed is available in the inspected original sources. The native compatible-manifest/ELF update mechanism is implemented and locally exercised; a public feed must be supplied by a publisher.
completion_policy: No broad complete-parity claim from a successful build or catalogue loading alone. Active implementation, finite tests and remaining host/live checks are recorded explicitly; source-inert fields and native platform adapters are named.
verified_host_integration: Production runtime sends SourceReadAllState on start/end/cancel/error and SourceUIAlert only from actual update/install outcomes. Core actual ReadAll/Cancel interaction receipt: dist/core-parity-ui/clicks.json.

Core.InstallNativePlugin explicitly enables the actual bundled Hecate worker and publishes real Ready identity/version messages. Nine production Core API tests include Ready disabled/self/version gates.

NativeOutput is latched at startup. Disabled shows the original anchored Arial20pt Native Output Disabled label after loading; optional Linux WebKit renderer is independent. Actual both-renderer zoom/persistence/focus/disabled checks are pinned by fixtures/bioinsights-visual-linux-qa.json.

Real GTK/WebKit DOM test preserves gallery identity/selection/credits and scroll on same-page updates; actual reparenting-X11 parent lookup test passes. See dist/embedded-browser-update/receipt.json and dist/embedded-browser-parent/receipt.json.

Independent native ELF worker updates stage atomically, activate all four only after restart and preserve complete builtin/remote projections. Actual local-server pipeline, rejection and SIGKILL-isolation proof: fixtures/native-updater-e2e-linux-qa.json.

Passive notification focus proof covers real X11 and supported Wayland layer-shell surfaces with focused synthetic game input, including a focus-stealing negative control. Unsupported compositors report a capability error; no focus-taking popup fallback. See fixtures/passive-notification-linux-qa.json.
